cards.ex: Seeing that old photo album really jogged my memory about our childhood trips.
cards.exUz: O'sha eski fotoalbomni ko'rish bolalikdagi sayohatlarimizni eslatdi.

cards.ex: I had a total senior moment and forgot where I parked the car.
cards.exUz: Men umuman keksalik xotirasiga duch keldim va mashinani qayerga qo'yganimni unutdim.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa muddatli xotira yo'qolishi, odatda keksalikda.

cards.ex: Bear in mind that the library closes early on Fridays.
cards.exUz: Juma kunlari kutubxona erta yopilishini yodda tuting.

cards.ex: I'm so sorry, it completely slipped my mind that we had a meeting today.
cards.exUz: Kechirasiz, bugun uchrashuvimiz borligi butunlay esimdan chiqib ketdi.

cards.ex: I've been racking my brains all day, but I can't remember her name.
cards.exUz: Men butun kun miyamni qorishtirdim, lekin uning ismini eslay olmayapman.

cards.ex: I'm in two minds about whether to go to the party or stay home.
cards.exUz: Partiyaga borish yoki uyda qolish haqida ikkilanmoqdaman.

cards.ex: Sorry, I lost my train of thought. What were we talking about?
cards.exUz: Kechirasiz, fikrimdan adashib qoldim. Biz nima haqida gaplashayotgan edik?

cards.ex: That name rings a bell, but I can't quite place him.
cards.exUz: Bu ism tanishdek tuyuladi, lekin uni aniqlay olmayapman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir tanish tuyuladi, lekin aniq esimda yo'q.

cards.ex: Her name is on the tip of my tongue... I'll remember it in a minute.
cards.exUz: Uning ismi tilim uchida... Bir daqiqada eslayman.
cards.term: on the tip of my tongue

cards.ex: I have a gut feeling that something good is going to happen.
cards.exUz: Menda yaxshi narsa sodir bo'lishi haqida ichki his bor.

cards.ex: I was out of my mind with worry when you didn't come home last night.
cards.exUz: Kechasi uyga kelmaganingizda, xavotirdan aqldan ozayozgan edim.

cards.ex: I'm finding it hard to get my head around these new rules.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi qoidalarni tushunish menga qiyin bo'lyapti.
cards.uzDef: Tushunish yoki qabul qilishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: That documentary gave me a lot of food for thought about the future.
cards.exUz: O'sha hujjatli film menga kelajak haqida o'ylash uchun ko'p narsa berdi.

cards.ex: Can I pick your brain about this project? You're the expert.
cards.exUz: Men sizdan bu loyiha haqida fikringizni so'rasam bo'ladimi? Siz mutaxassisiz.

cards.ex: I have a memory like a sieve; I forget everything immediately.
cards.exUz: Mening xotiram teshik, men hamma narsani darhol unutaman.

cards.ex: It did cross my mind that we might be late.
cards.exUz: Kechikishimiz mumkinligi xayolimdan o'tdi.

cards.ex: We had to learn the poem by heart for English class.
cards.exUz: Biz ingliz tili darsida she'rni yod olishimiz kerak edi.

cards.ex: To solve this problem, we need to think outside the box.
cards.exUz: Bu muammoni hal qilish uchun biz standartdan tashqari o'ylashimiz kerak.

cards.ex: The details of the accident are still fresh in my mind.
cards.exUz: Hodisa tafsilotlari hali ham xotiramda yangi.

cards.ex: I try to block out the bad things that happened in the past.
cards.exUz: Men o'tmishda yuz bergan yomon narsalarni esdan chiqarishga harakat qilaman.

cards.ex: I put two and two together and realized they were having an affair.
cards.exUz: Men ikkita va ikkitani qo'shib, ularning ishqiy munosabatda ekanligini angladim.

cards.ex: He had a brief lapse in memory and couldn't remember where he lived.
cards.exUz: Uning xotirasi qisqa muddatga pasaydi va qayerda yashashini eslay olmadi.

cards.ex: It's all about mind over matter; if you believe you can do it, you will.
cards.exUz: Bularning barchasi iroda kuchi haqida; agar siz bunga qodir ekanligingizga ishonsangiz, siz buni qilasiz.
cards.uzDef: Ruhiy kuch bilan jismoniy qiyinchiliklarni yengish.

cards.ex: I need to go for a walk to clear my head after that stressful meeting.
cards.exUz: O'sha stressli uchrashuvdan keyin miyamni tozalash uchun sayr qilishim kerak.

cards.ex: It's been at the back of my mind that I need to call my grandmother.
cards.exUz: Bu doimiy ravishda ong ostida turibdi, men buvimga qo'ng'iroq qilishim kerak.
cards.term: at the back of my mind
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda, lekin unchalik e'tiborga olinmaydigan.

cards.ex: I have a lot on my mind right now, so I'm a bit distracted.
cards.exUz: Hozirda xayolimda ko'p narsa bor, shuning uchun biroz chalg'iganman.

cards.ex: I'm going to lose my mind if I hear that song one more time.
cards.exUz: Agar yana bir marta o'sha qo'shiqni eshitsam, aqldan ozaman.

cards.ex: You need to get a grip and stop panicking.
cards.exUz: O'zingni qo'lga olishing va vahima qilishni to'xtatishing kerak.

cards.ex: I have a blind spot when it comes to technology.
cards.exUz: Texnologiya masalasida men ko'rmas nuqtaga egaman.

cards.ex: Hearing you were safe really eased my mind.
cards.exUz: Sizning xavfsiz ekanligingizni eshitish meni haqiqatan ham xotirjam qildi.
